_comment: Guided tour for the ChiMOL viewer embedded in ChiSurf's emtk host. Steps point at real regions of the host and wait for the user; the tour never presses anything.

steps.title: A viewer that is mostly molecule
steps.text: Menus, toolbar, sequence strip, object list, mouse block and command prompt are all drawn inside the 3-D view. Four steps.

steps.title: Open a structure
steps.text: Use File → Open or the Open button, pick an entry of the Demo menu, or type fetch 148l at the prompt.

await.hint: Open any structure; the step continues when a new object appears in the object list.

steps.title: Turn it
steps.text: Drag with the left button to rotate, the middle button to move, the right button to zoom. The mouse block at the bottom right lists every combination.

await.hint: Drag the molecule with the left mouse button.

steps.title: Say it instead
steps.text: Press Return to focus the prompt along the bottom edge, type a command such as show sticks or color red, sele, and press Return to run it.

await.hint: Run one command at the prompt.

steps.title: More help
steps.text: Help explains the object list, the menus and the command language; the guide page has the full reference.
